item.subject: science
item.stem: Priya connects the same nichrome wire first to one cell and then to two cells, keeping it connected for the same time in both cases. She also notices that the plug of her electric iron becomes warm after long use. Which statement is correct?

options.A: The wire becomes hotter with one cell than with two cells, and the warm plug of the iron shows useful heating.
options.B: The wire becomes hotter with two cells than with one cell, but the warm plug of the iron is harmful heating that may damage the plug.
options.C: Neither wire becomes hotter because the wire does not glow in either case.
options.D: The wire becomes hotter with two cells than with one cell, and all heating produced by electricity is useful.
